operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to use MySQL for the new service.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We're finalizing the stack for the new service. Can you review the database decision with me?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Of course. I can help review the database choice for the new service. What were you originally considering?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Earlier, I planned to use MySQL for the new service.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. So MySQL was the initial plan. What made you reconsider it?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I now plan to use Postgres for the new service.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. You've moved from MySQL to Postgres. Was there a specific comparison that drove that decision?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The change came from the feature-set comparison.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. Feature differences often decide the database choice. Is the decision documented for the rest of the team?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The choice is recorded in the ADR.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect, so the ADR captures the reasoning behind switching to Postgres. I'll use that as the reference going forward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Sounds good. I'll share the ADR link with the team after our sync.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great. I'll base any further recommendations on the Postgres decision and the recorded ADR.
